races.paceDynamic: Platino Bianco will likely lead from the gates with Alnofoor, Uncle Albert, and Rattletheonionbag providing early company in this 15-runner handicap. The heavy ground at 6f creates a tactical race where the prominent runners may struggle to sustain their effort, opening the door for hold-up horses to sweep up late. With 11 hold-up horses in the field, the pace could collapse in the final furlong if the early leaders fade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Early Speed Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Platino Bianco and the prominent runners maintain a steady gallop without going too hard early
scenarios.body: The leaders get first run on the heavy ground and the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the testing conditions. Platino Bianco or Uncle Albert could prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and the leaders weaken significantly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The mass of hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a strong pace to aim at and faltering leaders. Never Shout Never, Zephron, or Apache Star could time their run perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get into a waiting game and the pace becomes very steady throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with positioning crucial on the heavy ground. Horses like Ukiyo and Distillate who can quicken from midfield positions could benefit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Interference
scenarios.trigger: If the large field and heavy going cause significant interference or bunching in the straight
scenarios.body: Traffic problems allow an outsider to come through on the outside or benefit from a clear run. Half Nutz or My Kurkum could sneak into contention.

watchPoints.text: Platino Bianco must be watched for early fractions - if he goes too fast early he'll fade badly and set up the hold-up horses
Uncle Albert and My Kurkum both show fading patterns so watch their position turning for home
The large field of 15 runners on heavy ground creates high interference risk in the straight
Alnofoor and Polar Bear have poor heavy going records despite handling softer conditions
Watch for Never Shout Never and Apache Star getting clear runs from their hold-up positions

races.paceDynamic: Taipan is the lone confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable gallop in the heavy ground with three prominent racers (Star Harbour, What's Your Game) providing some company but not pressuring early. The overwhelming majority are hold-up horses who will need Taipan to fold late, creating a compressed finish where positioning and stamina will be crucial over this extended trip on energy-sapping ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Taipan Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner maintains his gallop and the heavy ground stops late closers
scenarios.body: Taipan's prominent style suits the conditions and he has winning form at this trip in good ground, while the hold-up brigade struggle to make inroads. The pace-setter holds on with What's Your Game and Star Harbour filling the places.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Proven Heavy Winner
scenarios.trigger: If recent heavy ground form proves decisive in the closing stages
scenarios.body: Galileo Dame won last time in heavy conditions over this trip and times her challenge perfectly, while Kizlyar has multiple heavy ground placings to draw upon. The experienced heavy ground performers surge past the tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Rises Late
scenarios.trigger: If Dawn Rising overcomes poor recent runs and shows his superior rating
scenarios.body: The 102-rated Dawn Rising finally produces his best form and uses his class advantage in the final furlong, with Jabbar's hold-up style working perfectly in the heavy conditions. Superior ability tells despite recent disappointments.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If What's Your Game positions more aggressively than usual and gets first run
scenarios.body: What's Your Game sits closer than normal and kicks before the hold-up horses can respond, capitalizing on his recent good form and better ground preference. His tactical switch catches the field napping.

races.paceDynamic: Duty Bound will likely lead uncontested with minimal early pressure, as the other prominent runners (Whats New, Grann's Boy, Young Churchill) typically settle just behind rather than challenge for the lead. This sustainable pace setup will favor the large contingent of hold-up horses, creating a tactical finish where stamina and late kick become crucial on the testing heavy ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Duty Bound Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Duty Bound gets his own way in front and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The pace-setter dictates terms and has enough left to resist late challenges on ground that suits his style. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late to make up the deficit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Staying Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run from halfway as prominent horses engage
scenarios.body: The heavy ground and extended distance find out the non-stayers as genuine stamina horses come to the fore. Sir Allen and Earthsong find their best trip but struggle to quicken late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect positioning as the race becomes tactical, with You Make Me Smile's recent heavy ground form proving decisive. Duty Bound pays for doing too much early work.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Finish
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running and the pace becomes crawling throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with horses getting in each other's way, allowing an unconsidered runner to steal through. Form goes out the window in the scramble.
